'''Marc Renaud''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship]] in March 2000 with Tatooine system with Court and Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, according to Yannick Lapointe's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d397">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-quebec-championshipd397/ quebec-championship], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-quebec-championshipd397/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
